_about: Clubs and sports as listed on the Wilcox High School website (source URLs below), collected 2026-09-24. Student-written details are added through the site; this file is only the official starting list.
sources: https://wilcox.santaclarausd.org/fs/elements/52778?is_popup=true&post_id=<id>&show_post=true (popup content for each of the 79 club posts)
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EokX2VyQlsmp5AojVMRaZDbtckmaU1mjlSwRpKSnhl0 (Activities Calendar 26-27; checked, not a club list)

clubs.name: Acts of Random Kindness Club
clubs.description: Acts of Random Kindness (ARK) Club strives to make Wilcox more welcoming for students and staff by creating a positive atmosphere and building community through uplifting campaigns, activities, and events such as appreciation letters, care packages, and kind notes. In ARK, we believe that even the smallest actions can have a big impact.

clubs.name: AI Club (Artificial Intelligence)
clubs.description: The Wilcox Artificial Intelligence Club introduces students to the world of AI and its growing role in shaping the future of technology, education, and careers. The club provides hands-on opportunities through workshops, competitions, internships, and volunteering to help students build valuable AI-related skills.

clubs.name: Ambassador Program
clubs.meets: Every first Tuesday of the month.
clubs.description: The Wilcox Ambassador Program works to alleviate the challenges experienced by newcomer English learning students and empowers them to succeed.

clubs.name: American Computer Science League
clubs.description: The ACSL Club’s mission is to help students explore advanced computer science concepts while preparing them for success in the ACSL tournaments.

clubs.name: Anime Club
clubs.description: The anime club is where we show a variety of anime genres monthly to introduce new anime and host a place for students to bond and interact with friends.

clubs.name: Associated Student Body (ASB)
clubs.description: Our Mission: Unite and encourage student enthusiasm to create a fun, inclusive environment.

clubs.name: Bangladeshi
clubs.description: The Bangladeshi Club is a club focused on educating people about the diverse cultures/traditions of Bangladesh. It is an inclusive environment for everyone to learn, and enjoy some snacks.

clubs.name: Best Buddies
clubs.description: The Best Buddies club serves as a safe space for all Wilcox High School students, providing an opportunity for students of all abilities to bond and connect through various crafts, lunches, and other fun activities!

clubs.name: Biology Club
clubs.description: The Biology Club serves to empower students with biological concepts, prepare students for future careers in science/medicine, create a safe space for students to meet like-minded peers, and deepen a love for life sciences!

clubs.name: Black Student Union (BSU)
clubs.description: The Black Student Union strives to increase cultural awareness through historical and educational trips as well as present college options and career paths for Black students.

clubs.name: Botany
clubs.meets: Monthly (description: during lunch in room S113)
clubs.description: The Botany Club is a plant-science club for students fond of biology, the study of plants, and environmental sustainability.

clubs.name: Bring Change to Mind (BC2M)
clubs.meets: We have officer meetings mostly on Mondays, and we have quad events every month.
clubs.description: Our club is about normalizing conversations about mental health. We want to end stigma and discrimination that has to do with mental illness.

clubs.name: California Scholastic Federation (CSF)
clubs.meets: Once in the first week of each month.
clubs.description: CSF is the California State High School Honor Society.

clubs.name: Cantonese
clubs.meets: Last Thursday of the month (once a month)
clubs.description: Cantonese Club is a fun space to learn about Cantonese culture through language, food, music, and traditions. We welcome all students, whether you’re fluent, learning, or just curious!

clubs.name: Chinese
clubs.description: The purpose of the Chinese Club is to raise awareness of Chinese traditions, cultures, and heritages on campus.

clubs.name: Coastal Conservation
clubs.description: The Coastal Conservation Crew is dedicated to preserving our environment. We host beach clean-ups once a month to help keep the shores clean, as well as get students involved in the community.

clubs.name: Compassion for Action
clubs.meets: Bimonthly, Wednesday, Thursday, or Friday (description: monthly meetings in B103)
clubs.description: CFA (Compassion for Action Club) strives to bring awareness to the situations of those in Santa Clara and the Bay Area who are struggling with homelessness, poverty, and food insecurity. We work to provide relief efforts such as donation drives, volunteer work, and educational meetings.

clubs.name: Competitive Coding Club (CCC)
clubs.description: The CCC's (Competitive Coding Club) main purpose is to bring together people of common interests in order to learn about and gain experience with competitive coding. Our main goals for this club are to prepare members for local and international competitive coding competitions such as USACO.

clubs.name: Cozy Cards
clubs.description: Our mission is to brighten the lives of seniors and children by creating personalized, heartfelt greeting cards.

clubs.name: Crochet Club
clubs.description: The Crochet Club aims to foster a community of creative people who love to crochet at Wilcox. We want to create a safe space in which students can express themselves through the art of crochet.

clubs.name: Cryptocurrency
clubs.meets: Biweekly, either Monday, Tuesday, or Thursday
clubs.description: The Wilcox Cryptocurrency Club introduces students to the world of cryptocurrency and blockchain technology, exploring how they shape the future of finance, technology, and careers.

clubs.name: Culinary Arts Club (CHAMPS Club)
clubs.description: The Culinary Arts Club promotes Culinary Arts and allows members to explore the use of culinary skillsets in relation to entrepreneurship, community service, and soft skills development. The Club also provides leadership opportunities within the club.

clubs.name: Dance
clubs.description: The Club aims to provide a welcoming space for dancers to connect, discuss, and share their interests in dance.

clubs.name: Dungeons and Dragons
clubs.description: Dungeons and Dragons is a social game; you have to work together towards a common goal.

clubs.name: Environmental Justice
clubs.description: The main purpose of the Environmental Justice Club is to address climate issues at both local and global scales, while introducing tangible environmental interactions to raise awareness and foster climate advocacy among youth.

clubs.name: Filipino-American Student Association (FASA)
clubs.description: FASA brings together Filipino American students as well as those who are interested in taking part in the culture through hosting monthly meetings, potlucks, and participating in the multicultural rally!

clubs.name: Forensics
clubs.meets: Once a month on Wednesdays or Tuesdays
clubs.description: The Wilcox Forensics Club invites you to dive into the world of crime labs, evidence analysis, and real-life investigative techniques.

clubs.name: French
clubs.description: The Wilcox French Club invites students interested in exploring the depths of Francophone culture!

clubs.name: Gender Sexuality Minority Alliance
clubs.description: GSMA is a safe space for LGBTQ+ and allied students to be themselves, meet other members of the community, and have fun.

clubs.name: Girl Up
clubs.meets: Meeting information will be posted on our Instagram, usually it's on the 3rd Tuesday of the month.
clubs.description: We advocate for girls around the world and for ending gender stigma and misogyny.

clubs.name: Girls Achieving in Non-Traditional Subjects (GAINS)
clubs.description: GAINS is always looking for hard-working, enthusiastic guest speakers at our monthly GAINS meetings.

clubs.name: Girls Who Code (GWC)
clubs.description: The Girls Who Code club at Wilcox is an extension of the national GWC Organization. This club was founded to educate, equip, and inspire girls with the computing skills they’ll need to pursue 21st-century opportunities.

clubs.name: Healing Art
clubs.meets: Once a month, the day will be decided by officer discussions in the group chat.
clubs.description: The club is for students to come in and do small arts and crafts. It's a type of therapy to help calm down the brain if someone is stressed.

clubs.name: Health Occupation Students of America (HOSA)
clubs.description: Wilcox HOSA (Health Occupations of America) is an international student-run organization meant to assist prospective health and medical students.

clubs.name: Indian Club
clubs.meets: Second week of every month during lunch
clubs.description: Indian Club is a cultural community that celebrates the richness of Indian heritage through dance, music, and events.

clubs.name: Interact Club
clubs.description: Wilcox Interact is a community service club affiliated with Interact District 5170.

clubs.name: Jewish Club
clubs.meets: Meetings mainly for Jewish holidays, with a few extra meetings during times when there aren't many holidays.
clubs.description: Our goal is to provide a safe space for Jewish students on campus as well as bring awareness to Jewish culture and traditions.

clubs.name: Justice Club
clubs.meets: Friday once or twice a month
clubs.description: The Wilcox Justice Club explores the world of law and justice through mock trials, guest speakers, and case studies.

clubs.name: Key Club
clubs.meets: We don't have a tentative schedule, but probably Monday or Tuesday
clubs.description: Key Club is a student-led service organization that focuses on community service, leadership development, and character building.

clubs.name: Korean Club
clubs.meets: Meeting information will be posted on our Instagram and be announced on the daily announcements
clubs.description: Korean club is a student-led organization that strives to share Korean culture through various ways within the Wilcox community

clubs.name: Kpop
clubs.description: It’s for students who are interested in K-pop and connecting with other students or making friends with people who share their interests.

clubs.name: Literature
clubs.description: Literature Club strives to promote reading and literature in the Wilcox community through interactive events and community service opportunities.

clubs.name: LSU (Latino Student Union) - MECHA
clubs.meets: Wednesday Biweekly; at lunch in room R 201.
clubs.description: The Latino Student Union is a cultural Hispanic club where everyone is welcome. We partake in many Latin American celebrations and in the multicultural Rally.

clubs.name: Math Club
clubs.description: Math Club is a dynamic group for students who love exploring the world of mathematics. We engage in fun challenges, problem-solving sessions, and competitions, all while fostering a collaborative and supportive environment.

clubs.name: Media Society Club
clubs.description: The Media Society is an adventure into the world of Video Productions.

clubs.name: Medical Equity and Diversity
clubs.description: The Wilcox Medical Equity (MED) club is dedicated to promoting equity within healthcare.

clubs.name: Music Club
clubs.description: Music Club intends to share the diversity of musical culture and unite music lovers through fun activities and events.

clubs.name: National Art Honor Society - Wilcox Chapter (NAHS)
clubs.description: The National Art Honor Society aims to bring art in numerous forms—whether through displays at school, art-related volunteer opportunities, and more—to all Wilcox students.

clubs.name: New Life Campus Outreach
clubs.meets: The club meets every other Tuesday

clubs.name: Origami Club
clubs.description: Origami Club is a place for people to enjoy the art of folding paper.

clubs.name: Pacific Islander Student Association
clubs.description: PISA aims to educate students about the Pacific Islands' culture. We also encourage students of various cultural backgrounds to share and learn about our culture.

clubs.name: Party Game
clubs.description: The Party Game Club provides short, easy-to-play games to help students socialize and meet new friends.

clubs.name: Physics
clubs.description: Physics Club is a club that is open to anyone curious and interested in physics and related sciences. This student-led club offers problem-solving workshops, preparation for competitions, and fun discussions about physics in the real world.

clubs.name: Pickleball
clubs.description: Pickleball Club is an exciting experience for all students involved.

clubs.name: Programming Club
clubs.description: Students who are interested in programming host an annual Hackathon and ongoing Cyber security learning.

clubs.name: Psychology Club
clubs.meets: Thursday during lunch once a month.
clubs.description: The Wilcox Psychology Club is for anyone curious about the field of psychology. We do fun activities, have discussions, and sometimes hear from guest speakers like the school psychologists.

clubs.name: Santa Clara Sister Cities (SCSC)
clubs.description: Santa Clara Sister Cities works with city council and schools across Santa Clara to foster international relationships and student exchanges.

clubs.name: Sideline Cheer
clubs.description: Currently our Sideline Cheer Teams, we have JV and Varsity, participate at our Football and Basketball games and may attend other sporting events as well. Tryouts for Sideline Cheer are in the Spring each year for the following year.

clubs.name: Song Pom Dance Team
clubs.description: Song Pom is a mixture of using Song Pom technique, Jazz and Hip Hop with Pom Pons to entertain our audiences throughout the majority of our routines.

clubs.name: Speech and Debate Club
clubs.description: Wilcox Speech & Debate Club was established by students of Wilcox High School to foster critical thinking, effective communication, and competitive debate skills.

clubs.name: Survival
clubs.meets: Last Tuesday of the month in S115
clubs.description: The Wilcox Survival Club is focused on teaching students fundamental survival skills. Anyone is welcome to join and be a member of our club.

clubs.name: Taiwanese Student Association (TSA)
clubs.meets: Once every month (description: in Ms. Slate's room)
clubs.description: The Wilcox Taiwanese Student Association is a student-run organization with guidance from the faculty advisor. All students who are interested in Taiwanese culture are welcome to join our monthly meetings in Ms. Slate's room.

clubs.name: United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund (UNICEF)
clubs.meets: Meeting information will be announced on the daily announcements.
clubs.description: Wilcox UNICEF partners with the U.S. Fund for UNICEF to educate, advocate, and fundraise — work that is vital to UNICEF's ability to save children in more than 190 countries and territories around the globe.

clubs.name: Vietnamese Student Association (VSA)
clubs.description: VSA is a student-organized club with the purpose of celebrating the Vietnamese language and culture through activities, as well as, enriching and educating the community about Vietnamese tradition.

clubs.name: Wilcox Animal Group (WAG)
clubs.meets: First Wednesday of every month, with some months having 2 meetings.
clubs.description: Wilcox Animal Group is a club that welcomes all animal lovers!

clubs.name: Wilcox Business Experience (WBE)
clubs.description: The Wilcox Business Experience (WBE) is a student-run organization that helps students explore business through competitions, internships, and community service. Our club provides hands-on opportunities to build professional skills while engaging with local organizations and events.

clubs.name: Wilcox Muslim Student Association (MSA)
clubs.description: Our club works to educate about the religion of Islam while creating a safe environment for Muslim students to connect and practice together.

clubs.name: Wilcox Robotics
clubs.meets: Every day after school 3-5 pm, Rm. P-120
clubs.description: Participates in FTC (First Tech Challenge) Team 8872 & 13190. Demonstrates the inner workings and nuances of robotics.

clubs.name: Wilcox Stage Company (WSC)
clubs.description: Wilcox Stage Company is an established club on the Wilcox campus and is responsible for working in conjunction with our productions course to produce the shows at Wilcox. Club members enjoy field trips, real-world tech, and performance experience.

clubs.name: Wilcox Stock Market Analysis Club (SMA)
clubs.meets: Meeting information will be posted on our Instagram.
clubs.description: To empower our members with the knowledge, skills, and insights needed to excel in the dynamic world of the stock market and investing.

notes: CLUBS: The official Clubs page (/activities/clubs) lists 79 clubs as Finalsite 'posts' that open in a popup; their text is not in the page HTML and was read from the popup endpoint /fs/elements/52778?is_popup=true&post_id=<id>&show_post=true. Those popups have no standalone page URL, so 'url' is null for them. Each post shows a date: 39 are dated Aug-Dec 2023, 4 May 2024, 34 Jan-Feb 2026, 1 May 2026 and 1 Aug 2026 (Programming Club). These look like original publish dates rather than last-edit dates, since several 2023 posts have clearly been edited since, but the 2023 ones may still carry stale advisors or meeting details. Meeting details are copied verbatim, including vague ones ('Monthly', 'Bimonthly, Wednesday, Thursday, or Friday'); where a room appears only in the description it is added in parentheses. Clubs with blank Description/Meeting fields on the site (description or meets left null): Card Game, Chemistry, Creative Writing, Dub C Film Crew, Genes in Diseases and Symptoms, Japanese Club, Magic the Gathering, New Life Campus Outreach, Science Squad, Sikh Honors and Service, Student Engagement in Environmental Discovery, Student Performance and Athlete Resilience, Wilcox Cricket Club, Wilcox Mentorship Association (no advisor either), Wilcox Robotics (filled from its /activities/clubs/robotics page). Speech and Debate has no advisor listed. Magic the Gathering's post shows the Party Game club's Instagram handle, apparently a copy-paste error. Compassion for Action says 'Bimonthly' in Meeting Details but 'monthly meetings' in its description. The site's own topic filter tags (Arts/Crafts, Diversity, Entertainment, Health and Wellness, Service, STEM) were used as a hint; the 'category' field is our best-fit mapping, not a school label. MERGES: Wilcox Robotics merges the club post with /activities/clubs/robotics (FTC Teams 8872 & 13190; 'Mrs. Hardy'; room P-120). Wilcox Business Experience merges the club post (advisor 'Tony Raffetto') with its own page (advisor 'Anthony Raffetto'; 'We used to be called DECA'). Wilcox Stage Company links to the Wilcox Theater page, which says WSC is the theater group that, with the Theater Productions Honors class, typically produces two shows a year (Fall and Spring). ADDED FROM ACTIVITIES PAGES (not on the Clubs list): ASB (no advisor named; contacts are the VP of Activities and the ASB Secretary; the page also lists the 2026-27 ASB and class councils), GAINS (contact Kenny Contreras; also mentions Mr. Beadell), and the three Performance Groups: Song Pom Dance Team, Sideline Cheer, and Wilcox Music. Wilcox Music links only to the external boosters site https://whmboosters.com/, so url is null. Also Wilcox Yearbook (advisor Ms. Sanghee Krause). Left out as not clubs: CHAMPs Cafe (a student-run restaurant operated by the second-year C.H.A.M.P. culinary program; the club is 'Culinary Arts Club (CHAMPS Club)'), MakerSpace (a facility), Computer Science Showcase (class websites), Class Pages / Senior Class (mostly empty templates). The Activities Calendar Google Sheet (1EokX2Vy...) was checked; it is a 2026-27 events calendar, not a club list. No Google Doc club list was found. SPORTS: Names are as on the Athletics homepage (the contact page adds: Badminton (Co-ed), Swimming and Diving (Boys' and Girls'), Track and Field (Co-Ed)). Team list and seasons come from the Athletics homepage's Fall/Winter/Spring team tabs. Levels come from the '2025-2026' block of Athletic Participation Data (updated June 30, 2026). Combined teams merge both genders' levels: Cross Country = Boys Varsity & Frosh-Soph, Girls Varsity & JV; Track & Field = the same split; Swimming & Diving = Boys Varsity/Frosh-Soph, Girls Varsity/JV. Football is 'Varsity / Frosh-Soph and Frosh'; Girls Volleyball is 'Varsity / Junior Varsity/Fresh'. Badminton, Boys Wrestling and Girls Wrestling are listed as 'Varsity and Junior Varsity' combined. Coaches come from Coach and Athletic Director Contact (head coach per sport) plus staff named on the team's own page. Conflicts: Girls Lacrosse lists Morgan Smith on the contact page but 'John Buter' (sic, maybe 'John Butler', the softball coach) as Head Coach on the team page; both are kept. Boys Tennis and Boys Volleyball show 'TBD' (their pages name only an athletic director), so coaches is []. The contact page writes Joshua Foley as 'Josh Foley' and Competitive Sport Cheer as 'Competitive Sport Cheer, Stunt'. The Sideline Cheer page says 'Coach - Cassidy Joyce'; the cheer team page says 'Coach Cassidy'. Girls Tennis has an unfilled 'Head JV Coach' ('Info coming soon'). Trainer Wilson Hsieh and the athletic directors (Paul Rosa, Laura Stott Hardesty) are not listed as coaches. Teams whose 'Learn More' goes to an off-site page (url null here): Cross Country and Track and Field -> wilcoxrunning.org; Football -> sites.google.com/scusd.net/wilcoxfootball; Girls Volleyball -> sites.google.com/scusd.net/wilcoxgirlsvolleyball; Boys and Girls Water Polo and Swimming & Diving -> wilcoxaquatics.weebly.com. These were not scraped. Former sports that appear only in older participation data (Field Hockey through 2023-24; co-ed Wrestling before 2019-20) are not included. Season start dates stated on the Athletics page: fall begins at the beginning of August, winter at the end of October or beginning of November (Winter 2026: November 2, 2026), spring at the end of January or early February (Spring 2027: February 1, 2027). The eligibility page itself has no per-sport list. No emails or phone numbers were recorded, and no student officer names.
